'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Catatumbo campaign]]
***[[2025 Catatumbo attacks]]
****The [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] (ELN) and [[FARC dissidents]] exchange heavy fire across the {{ill|Catatumbo region|es|Región del Catatumbo}}, [[Colombia]], killing at least 80 people and injuring hundreds of others, with an unknown number of people also reportedly being kidnapped, after the ELN accused the FARC dissidents of killing civilians in the area. Thousands of people have fled their homes due to the fighting. The [[National Army of Colombia|Colombian Army]] says that it has rescued dozens of people, while [[Government of Colombia|the government]] calls on the ELN to cease their attacks immediately. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/kidnapped-colombia-peace-talks-fail-rebel-national-liberation-army/ (CBS News)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***The [[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|Gaza ceasefire agreement]] formally goes into effect, with the first hostages and prisoners freed as part of the deal. [https://edition.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-hamas-ceasefire-war-palestine-01-19-25/index.html (CNN)] 
**[[Israel]] announces that [[Israel Defense Forces|its troops]] have recovered the body of [[staff sergeant]] [[Deaths and ransoming of Oron Shaul and Hadar Goldin#Oron Shaul|Oron Shaul]], who was captured and killed by [[Hamas]] in 2014. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/body-of-oron-shaul-killed-and-captured-by-hamas-in-2014-recovered-from-gaza/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
* The ''[[Washington Post]]'' reports that there is an "emerging consensus" among U.S. and European intelligence officials that maritime accidents, rather than Russian sabotage, was the cause of damage to Baltic seabed energy and communications lines. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2025/01/19/russia-baltic-undersea-cables-accidents-sabotage/ (Washington Post)]
*[[2025 California wildfires]]
**[[January 2025 Southern California wildfires]]
***[[California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection|Cal Fire]] reports that the [[Palisades Fire]] is more than 50% contained, while the [[Eaton Fire]] is more than 80% contained. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/antoniopequenoiv/2025/01/19/california-wildfire-updates-palisades-fire-finally-over-50-contained/ (''Forbes'')]
*A bus crashed into a concrete centre barrier in [[Eastern Cape]], killing five and injuring six. [https://news365.co.za/head-on-collision-25/ (news365)]
*Four people are killed after a house caught fire from a short circuit in [[Ghaziabad]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/uttar-pradesh/fire-breaks-out-in-house-in-ghaziabad-four-killed/article69115550.ece (The Hindu)]
*Three people are killed and four are missing after a boat carrying 17 people capsized near [[Golaghat]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/bihar/people-missing-some-dead-as-boat-capsizes-in-ganga-in-bihars-katihar/article69115808.ece (The Hindu)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**[[Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol]]
***[[Yoon Suk Yeol]] becomes the first sitting [[president of South Korea]] to be formally arrested, following his [[2024 South Korean martial law crisis|declaration of martial law]] in December. [https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250118038600004?section=society/all (Yonhap)]
***Following Yoon's arrest, pro-Yoon protesters raid the [[Seoul]] [[Judiciary of South Korea|Western District Court]], resulting in 41 injuries and property damage. [https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250119008151004 (Yonhap)]
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]], [[Islam and blasphemy]]
**An [[Iran]]ian court sentences singer [[Amir Tataloo]] to death on appeal after Tataloo was convicted of [[Criticism of Muhammad|insulting]] the [[prophet Muhammad]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/01/19/iran-court-sentences-pop-singer-tataloo-to-death (Al Arabiya)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**Three ministers of the [[Government of Israel]] belonging to the [[Otzma Yehudit]] party resign in protest of the approved [[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|Gaza ceasefire agreement]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/otzma-yehudit-exits-coalition-over-gaza-deal-blasting-it-as-victory-for-terrorism/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Restrictions on TikTok in the United States]]
**[[Social media]] platform [[TikTok]] temporarily suspends most of its services in the [[United States]] as the [[Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act]] goes into effect. TikTok restores these services, but its app remains unavailable in U.S. markets on the [[App Store (Apple)|App Store]] and [[Google Play]]. [https://people.com/tiktok-working-to-restore-service-in-us-less-than-24-hours-after-ban-8777120 (''People'')] [https://apnews.com/article/tiktok-ban-trump-biden-china-bdc79b7ce741a81761f67ea56d410103 (AP)]
